title: Tim Taylor shows Grant the jump room building
place_text: former aircraft building turned office complex

tellings.quote: And then he says, and then he says, oh, I don't remember, but he said, this is where the jump room was, or this is the jump, this is the story of the jump room.

plain: In 2013, a man named Timothy Taylor is said to have shown a visitor a former aircraft building that had become an office complex, and told him this was where the "jump room" had been, a room with a story of its own. The visitor was Grant Cameron, a guest on American Alchemy who tells it as something he saw first-hand. He recalls Taylor saying "this is where the jump room was, or this is the jump, this is the story of the jump room," though Cameron admits he does not remember the exact words.
